147-728-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-728-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7825.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

4399-4770-5998-7173.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3240-5147-5632-6462.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2445-4050-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Branching Evolution.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Branching Evolution.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2438-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2511-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5921-5970-6965--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-6965--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5921-5970-6965--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

222-527-5256-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2173-3239-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

585-1238-2351-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2.

252-5394-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

338-1545-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1545-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1580-4647-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2999-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2999-3490-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Impassioned Orator indestructible.
2999-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1116-3240-4616-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-4616-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Moldervine Reclamation and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Moldervine Reclamation and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

955-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
955-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3389-4050-4772-5043.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

687-1833-2034-3818.notablePrerequisites: Stormbound Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-1833-2034-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {C}{C}.
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Stormbound Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Stormbound Geist.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Stormbound Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1985-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Liberated Livestock, adding {C}{C}.
When Liberated Livestock dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Liberated Livestock trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat, a 1/1 Bird, and a 2/4 Ox creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Liberated Livestock from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

254-301-2438.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
254-301-2438.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}, causing all creatures that enter the battlefield under your control this turn to get an additional +1/+1 counter put on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
Putrid Goblin's persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering First Day of Class, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2367-3490-4647.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers twice, costing you {2} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

1295-1368-1778-4143-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have four or more cards in your graveyard.
1295-1368-1778-4143-5256.description:
Cast Underworld Breach.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite, milling yourself for three.
Cast Memnite by exiling three cards from your graveyard that are not Thassa's Oracle.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until you have no cards in library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle.
Resolve its enter the battlefield trigger.

2190-3693.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista deathtouch.
2190-3693.description:
Give Walking Ballista deathtouch.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat steps 2-3.
